Signed-off-by: Misaka19280hw <xuzhanxiang1@huawei.com>

* [TritonToLinalg](fix) Follow upstream scaled-dot scale conversion

* [Tests](fix) Respect fast_math in scaled-dot reference

* [TritonToLinalg](fix) Preserve scaled-dot fast-math decoding

+// RUN: triton-opt --triton-to-linalg="named-ops=True compile-on-910-95=true" --split-input-file %s | FileCheck %s
+// RUN: triton-opt --triton-to-linalg="named-ops=True compile-on-910-95=false" --split-input-file %s | FileCheck %s
+
+// CHECK-LABEL: func.func @e8m0_boundaries
+// E8M0 code 0 is the BF16 subnormal 2^-127 (bits 64).
+// CHECK-DAG: arith.constant{{.*}}64{{.*}}i16
+// CHECK: arith.cmpi eq
+// CHECK: arith.select
+// CHECK: arith.bitcast {{.*}} : tensor<16x1xi16> to tensor<16x1xbf16>
+// Code 255 is masked to NaN after scaling, as in upstream maskNan.
+// CHECK: arith.mulf
+// CHECK: arith.cmpi eq
+// CHECK: arith.select
+// CHECK: linalg.matmul
+func.func @e8m0_boundaries(%a: tensor<16x32xbf16>, %b: tensor<32x32xbf16>, %sa: tensor<16x1xi8>, %sb: tensor<32x1xi8>, %c: tensor<16x32xf32>) -> tensor<16x32xf32> {
+  %d = tt.dot_scaled %a scale %sa, %b scale %sb, %c lhs = bf16 rhs = bf16 {fastMath = false} : tensor<16x32xbf16>, tensor<16x1xi8> * tensor<32x32xbf16>, tensor<32x1xi8> -> tensor<16x32xf32>
+  return %d : tensor<16x32xf32>
+}
+
+// -----
+
+// Fast math keeps the upstream exponent-bit decode for both operands.
+// In particular, code 0 must not get the strict-mode subnormal correction.
+// CHECK-LABEL: func.func @e8m0_fast_math
+// CHECK: arith.extui {{.*}} : tensor<16x1xi8> to tensor<16x1xi16>
+// CHECK: arith.shli
+// CHECK-NEXT: {{.*}}arith.bitcast {{.*}} : tensor<16x1xi16> to tensor<16x1xbf16>
+// CHECK: arith.extui {{.*}} : tensor<1x32xi8> to tensor<1x32xi16>
+// CHECK: arith.shli
+// CHECK-NEXT: {{.*}}arith.bitcast {{.*}} : tensor<1x32xi16> to tensor<1x32xbf16>
+// CHECK-NOT: arith.select
+// CHECK: linalg.matmul
+func.func @e8m0_fast_math(%a: tensor<16x32xbf16>, %b: tensor<32x32xbf16>, %sa: tensor<16x1xi8>, %sb: tensor<32x1xi8>, %c: tensor<16x32xf32>) -> tensor<16x32xf32> {
+  %d = tt.dot_scaled %a scale %sa, %b scale %sb, %c lhs = bf16 rhs = bf16 {fastMath = true} : tensor<16x32xbf16>, tensor<16x1xi8> * tensor<32x32xbf16>, tensor<32x1xi8> -> tensor<16x32xf32>
+  return %d : tensor<16x32xf32>
+}
+
+// -----
+
+// FP16 scales must take the upstream integer -> FP32 -> FP16 path.
+// CHECK-LABEL: func.func @e8m0_fp16
+// CHECK-NOT: bf16
+// CHECK: arith.extui {{.*}} : tensor<16x1xi8> to tensor<16x1xi32>
+// CHECK-NOT: bf16
+// CHECK: arith.bitcast {{.*}} : tensor<16x1xi32> to tensor<16x1xf32>
+// CHECK-NEXT: {{.*}}arith.truncf {{.*}} : tensor<16x1xf32> to tensor<16x1xf16>
+// CHECK-NOT: bf16
+// CHECK: arith.extui {{.*}} : tensor<1x32xi8> to tensor<1x32xi32>
+// CHECK: arith.bitcast {{.*}} : tensor<1x32xi32> to tensor<1x32xf32>
+// CHECK-NEXT: {{.*}}arith.truncf {{.*}} : tensor<1x32xf32> to tensor<1x32xf16>
+// CHECK-NOT: bf16
+// CHECK: linalg.matmul
+func.func @e8m0_fp16(%a: tensor<16x32xf16>, %b: tensor<32x32xf16>, %sa: tensor<16x1xi8>, %sb: tensor<32x1xi8>, %c: tensor<16x32xf32>) -> tensor<16x32xf32> {
+  %d = tt.dot_scaled %a scale %sa, %b scale %sb, %c lhs = fp16 rhs = fp16 {fastMath = false} : tensor<16x32xf16>, tensor<16x1xi8> * tensor<32x32xf16>, tensor<32x1xi8> -> tensor<16x32xf32>
+  return %d : tensor<16x32xf32>
+}
+
+// -----
+
+// CHECK-LABEL: func.func @floating_rhs_scale
+// CHECK: arith.extf {{.*}} : tensor<2x32xf8E4M3FN> to tensor<2x32xbf16>
+// CHECK: arith.mulf {{.*}} : tensor<32x32xbf16>
+// CHECK: arith.cmpf une
+// CHECK: linalg.matmul
+func.func @floating_rhs_scale(%a: tensor<16x32xbf16>, %b: tensor<32x32xbf16>, %sb: tensor<32x2xf8E4M3FN>, %c: tensor<16x32xf32>) -> tensor<16x32xf32> {
+  %d = tt.dot_scaled %a, %b scale %sb, %c lhs = bf16 rhs = bf16 {fastMath = false} : tensor<16x32xbf16> * tensor<32x32xbf16>, tensor<32x2xf8E4M3FN> -> tensor<16x32xf32>
+  return %d : tensor<16x32xf32>
+}

+# Copyright (c) Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 2026. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch_npu  # noqa: F401
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+from triton.backends.ascend.utils import is_compile_on_910_95
+from triton.compiler.errors import CompilationError
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _scaled_dot(a_ptr, b_ptr, sa_ptr, sb_ptr, out_ptr, M: tl.constexpr, N: tl.constexpr, K: tl.constexpr,
+                A_FORMAT: tl.constexpr, B_FORMAT: tl.constexpr, A_K_PACK: tl.constexpr, B_K_PACK: tl.constexpr,
+                GROUP: tl.constexpr, INITIAL: tl.constexpr = .125, OUT_DTYPE: tl.constexpr = tl.float32):
+    AM: tl.constexpr = M // 2 if A_FORMAT == "e2m1" and not A_K_PACK else M
+    AK: tl.constexpr = K // 2 if A_FORMAT == "e2m1" and A_K_PACK else K
+    BK: tl.constexpr = K // 2 if B_FORMAT == "e2m1" and B_K_PACK else K
+    BN: tl.constexpr = N // 2 if B_FORMAT == "e2m1" and not B_K_PACK else N
+    a = tl.load(a_ptr + tl.arange(0, AM)[:, None] * AK + tl.arange(0, AK)[None, :])
+    b = tl.load(b_ptr + tl.arange(0, BK)[:, None] * BN + tl.arange(0, BN)[None, :])
+    sa = None
+    sb = None
+    if sa_ptr is not None:
+        sa = tl.load(sa_ptr + tl.arange(0, M)[:, None] * (K // GROUP) + tl.arange(0, K // GROUP)[None, :])
+    if sb_ptr is not None:
+        sb = tl.load(sb_ptr + tl.arange(0, N)[:, None] * (K // GROUP) + tl.arange(0, K // GROUP)[None, :])
+    acc = tl.full((M, N), INITIAL, OUT_DTYPE)
+    out = tl.dot_scaled(a, sa, A_FORMAT, b, sb, B_FORMAT, acc, lhs_k_pack=A_K_PACK, rhs_k_pack=B_K_PACK,
+                        out_dtype=OUT_DTYPE)
+    tl.store(out_ptr + tl.arange(0, M)[:, None] * N + tl.arange(0, N)[None, :], out)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("code,exponent,expected", [(0, 120, .25), (254, -120, 4096.)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("side", ["lhs", "rhs"])
+def test_dot_scaled_e8m0_extreme(code, exponent, expected, side):
+    # Compensating operand exponents make the final result normal and finite.
+    # A near-zero expected result would hide an incorrect zero-scale decode.
+    m, n, k = 16, 32, 32
+    a = torch.full((m, k), 2.**exponent if side == "lhs" else 1., dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="npu")
+    b = torch.full((k, n), 2.**exponent if side == "rhs" else 1., dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="npu")
+    scale = torch.full((m if side == "lhs" else n, 1), code, dtype=torch.uint8, device="npu")
+    actual = torch.empty((m, n), dtype=torch.float32, device="npu")
+    _scaled_dot[(1, )](a, b, scale if side == "lhs" else None, scale if side == "rhs" else None, actual, m, n, k,
+                       "bf16", "bf16", True, True, 32, INITIAL=0.)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual.cpu(), torch.full((m, n), expected), atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("side", ["lhs", "rhs"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("scale_format", ["e8m0", "e4m3"])
+def test_dot_scaled_scale_nan(side, scale_format):
+    if scale_format == "e4m3" and not is_compile_on_910_95(triton.runtime.driver.active.get_current_target().arch):
+        pytest.skip("FP8 scales require Ascend 950")
+    m, n, k = 16, 32, 32
+    a = torch.ones((m, k), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="npu")
+    b = torch.ones((k, n), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="npu")
+    group = 32 if scale_format == "e8m0" else 16
+    dtype = torch.uint8 if scale_format == "e8m0" else torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    scale = torch.full((m if side == "lhs" else n, k // group), 127 if scale_format == "e8m0" else 1., dtype=dtype)
+    scale[3, 0] = 255 if scale_format == "e8m0" else float("nan")
+    scale = scale.npu()
+    expected = torch.full((m, n), k + .125)
+    if side == "lhs":
+        expected[3, :] = float("nan")
+    else:
+        expected[:, 3] = float("nan")
+    actual = torch.empty((m, n), dtype=torch.float32, device="npu")
+    _scaled_dot[(1, )](a, b, scale if side == "lhs" else None, scale if side == "rhs" else None, actual, m, n, k,
+                       "bf16", "bf16", True, True, group)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual.cpu(), expected, atol=0, rtol=0, equal_nan=True)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("with_lhs,with_rhs", [(False, False), (False, True), (True, False), (True, True)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("scale_format", ["e8m0", "e4m3"])
+def test_dot_scaled_optional_and_floating_scales(with_lhs, with_rhs, scale_format):
+    if scale_format == "e4m3" and not is_compile_on_910_95(triton.runtime.driver.active.get_current_target().arch):
+        pytest.skip("FP8 scales require Ascend 950")
+    m, n, k = 16, 32, 32
+    a = torch.ones((m, k), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="npu")
+    b = torch.ones((k, n), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="npu")
+    group = 32 if scale_format == "e8m0" else 16
+    dtype = torch.uint8 if scale_format == "e8m0" else torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    sa = torch.full((m, k // group), 128 if scale_format == "e8m0" else 2., dtype=dtype).npu() if with_lhs else None
+    sb = torch.full((n, k // group), 126 if scale_format == "e8m0" else .5, dtype=dtype).npu() if with_rhs else None
+    actual = torch.empty((m, n), dtype=torch.float32, device="npu")
+    _scaled_dot[(1, )](a, b, sa, sb, actual, m, n, k, "bf16", "bf16", True, True, group)
+    expected = torch.full((m, n), k * (2. if with_lhs else 1.) * (.5 if with_rhs else 1.) + .125)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual.cpu(), expected, atol=0, rtol=0)

+import torch
+import torch_npu  # noqa: F401
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+from triton.backends.ascend.utils import is_compile_on_910_95
+from triton.compiler.errors import CompilationError
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _scaled_dot(a_ptr, b_ptr, sa_ptr, sb_ptr, out_ptr, M: tl.constexpr, N: tl.constexpr, K: tl.constexpr,
+                A_FORMAT: tl.constexpr, B_FORMAT: tl.constexpr, OUT_DTYPE: tl.constexpr = tl.float32):
+    a = tl.load(a_ptr + tl.arange(0, M)[:, None] * K + tl.arange(0, K)[None, :])
+    b = tl.load(b_ptr + tl.arange(0, K)[:, None] * N + tl.arange(0, N)[None, :])
+    sa = tl.load(sa_ptr + tl.arange(0, M)[:, None] * (K // 32) + tl.arange(0, K // 32)[None, :])
+    sb = None
+    if sb_ptr is not None:
+        sb = tl.load(sb_ptr + tl.arange(0, N)[:, None] * (K // 32) + tl.arange(0, K // 32)[None, :])
+    acc = tl.full((M, N), .125, OUT_DTYPE)
+    out = tl.dot_scaled(a, sa, A_FORMAT, b, sb, B_FORMAT, acc, out_dtype=OUT_DTYPE)
+    tl.store(out_ptr + tl.arange(0, M)[:, None] * N + tl.arange(0, N)[None, :], out)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("a_format,b_format", [("fp16", "bf16"), ("bf16", "fp16"), ("bf16", "bf16"), ("e4m3", "bf16"),
+                                               ("bf16", "e5m2"), ("fp16", "e5m2")])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rhs_scale", [False, True])
+def test_dot_scaled_operand_types(a_format, b_format, rhs_scale):
+    if any(fmt in ("e4m3", "e5m2") for fmt in (a_format, b_format)) and not is_compile_on_910_95():
+        pytest.skip("FP8 operand conversion requires A5")
+    dtypes = {"fp16": torch.float16, "bf16": torch.bfloat16, "e4m3": torch.float8_e4m3fn, "e5m2": torch.float8_e5m2}
+    m, n, k = 16, 32, 64
+    a = ((torch.arange(m * k).reshape(m, k) % 17 - 8).float() / 8).to(dtypes[a_format])
+    b = ((torch.arange(k * n).reshape(k, n) % 13 - 6).float() / 8).to(dtypes[b_format])
+    sa = torch.tensor([128, 126], dtype=torch.uint8).repeat(m, 1).npu()
+    sb = torch.tensor([126, 128], dtype=torch.uint8).repeat(n, 1).npu() if rhs_scale else None
+    actual = torch.empty((m, n), dtype=torch.float32, device="npu")
+    _scaled_dot[(1, )](a.npu(), b.npu(), sa, sb, actual, m, n, k, a_format, b_format)
+
+    # Upstream converts both operands before applying scales in FP16/BF16.
+    compute_dtype = torch.float16 if "fp16" in (a_format, b_format) else torch.bfloat16
+    a_scaled = a.to(compute_dtype) * torch.tensor([2., .5], dtype=compute_dtype).repeat_interleave(32)
+    b_scaled = b.to(compute_dtype)
+    if rhs_scale:
+        b_scaled = b_scaled * torch.tensor([.5, 2.], dtype=compute_dtype).repeat_interleave(32)[:, None]
+    expected = a_scaled.float() @ b_scaled.float() + .125
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual.cpu(), expected, atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
+def test_dot_scaled_converts_before_scaling():
+    # The BF16 value is halfway to the smallest FP16 subnormal: RTNE gives 0.
+    # Scaling first in FP32 would instead preserve a nonzero contribution.
+    m, n, k = 16, 32, 32
+    a = torch.full((m, k), 2.**-25, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="npu")
+    b = torch.ones((k, n), dtype=torch.float16, device="npu")
+    sa = torch.full((m, 1), 128, dtype=torch.uint8, device="npu")
+    actual = torch.empty((m, n), dtype=torch.float32, device="npu")
+    _scaled_dot[(1, )](a, b, sa, None, actual, m, n, k, "bf16", "fp16")
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual.cpu(), torch.full((m, n), .125), atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("out_dtype", [tl.float16, tl.bfloat16])
+def test_dot_scaled_rejects_non_f32_output(out_dtype):
+    a = torch.ones((16, 32), dtype=torch.float16, device="npu")
+    b = torch.ones((32, 32), dtype=torch.float16, device="npu")
+    sa = torch.full((16, 1), 127, dtype=torch.uint8, device="npu")
+    out = torch.empty((16, 32), dtype=torch.float32, device="npu")
+    with pytest.raises(CompilationError, match="Only float32 is supported for out_dtype"):
+        _scaled_dot[(1, )](a, b, sa, None, out, 16, 32, 32, "fp16", "fp16", OUT_DTYPE=out_dtype)

+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch_npu
+import triton

+@triton.jit
+def implicit_permute_gather_kernel(in_ptr0, in_ptr1, out_ptr0, N, M, BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr):
+    """Implicit transpose with data-dependent gather offsets along the innermost axis."""
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    row = pid * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)[:, None]
+    col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)[None, :]
+    row_mask = row < N
+    col_mask = col < M
+    offsets_x = tl.load(in_ptr0 + col, mask=col_mask, other=0)
+    addr = offsets_x * N + row
+    mask = row_mask & col_mask
+    val = tl.load(in_ptr1 + addr, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(out_ptr0 + (row * M + col), val, mask=mask)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def row_gather_load_kernel(in_ptr0, in_ptr1, out_ptr0, N, M, BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr):
+    """Row gather with a contiguous innermost axis, without implicit transpose."""
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    row = pid * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)[:, None]
+    col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)[None, :]
+    row_mask = row < N
+    col_mask = col < M
+    offsets_y = tl.load(in_ptr0 + row, mask=row_mask, other=0)
+    addr = offsets_y * M + col
+    mask = row_mask & col_mask
+    val = tl.load(in_ptr1 + addr, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(out_ptr0 + (row * M + col), val, mask=mask)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("N,M", [

+    (100, 50),
+    (257, 64),
+    (128, 8),
+])

+    block_n = 128

+    data = test_common.generate_tensor((n_rows, N if implicit_permute_gather else M), "float16")
+    expected = data[indices.long()].float()
+    if implicit_permute_gather:
+        expected = expected.t()
+
+    output = torch.empty((N, M), dtype=torch.float32, device="npu")
+    kernel = implicit_permute_gather_kernel if implicit_permute_gather else row_gather_load_kernel
+    grid = (triton.cdiv(N, block_n), )
+    kernel[grid](indices.npu(), data.npu(), output, N, M, BLOCK_N=block_n, BLOCK_M=block_m, compile_mode="simd")

+@triton.jit
+def data_mask_gather_kernel(indices, data, output, D: tl.constexpr, N: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_D: tl.constexpr,

+    d = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_D)
+    n = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)

+    tl.store(output + d[:, None] * N + n[None, :], value, mask=(d < D)[:, None] & (n < N)[None, :])
+

+def test_implicit_permute_data_mask(D, N, broadcast_mask):
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    n_rows = 23
+    block_n = triton.next_power_of_2(N)
+    indices = torch.arange(N, dtype=torch.int32) % n_rows
+    # Interleaved invalid lanes cannot be represented by one interval bound.

+import pytest

+@triton.jit
+def _scaled_dot(a_ptr, b_ptr, sa_ptr, sb_ptr, out_ptr, M: tl.constexpr, N: tl.constexpr, K: tl.constexpr,
+                A_FORMAT: tl.constexpr, B_FORMAT: tl.constexpr, A_K_PACK: tl.constexpr, B_K_PACK: tl.constexpr,
+                GROUP: tl.constexpr, INITIAL: tl.constexpr = .125, OUT_DTYPE: tl.constexpr = tl.float32):
+    AM: tl.constexpr = M // 2 if A_FORMAT == "e2m1" and not A_K_PACK else M
+    AK: tl.constexpr = K // 2 if A_FORMAT == "e2m1" and A_K_PACK else K
+    BK: tl.constexpr = K // 2 if B_FORMAT == "e2m1" and B_K_PACK else K
+    BN: tl.constexpr = N // 2 if B_FORMAT == "e2m1" and not B_K_PACK else N
+    a = tl.load(a_ptr + tl.arange(0, AM)[:, None] * AK + tl.arange(0, AK)[None, :])
+    b = tl.load(b_ptr + tl.arange(0, BK)[:, None] * BN + tl.arange(0, BN)[None, :])
+    sa = None
+    sb = None
+    if sa_ptr is not None:
+        sa = tl.load(sa_ptr + tl.arange(0, M)[:, None] * (K // GROUP) + tl.arange(0, K // GROUP)[None, :])
+    if sb_ptr is not None:
+        sb = tl.load(sb_ptr + tl.arange(0, N)[:, None] * (K // GROUP) + tl.arange(0, K // GROUP)[None, :])
+    acc = tl.full((M, N), INITIAL, OUT_DTYPE)
+    out = tl.dot_scaled(a, sa, A_FORMAT, b, sb, B_FORMAT, acc, lhs_k_pack=A_K_PACK, rhs_k_pack=B_K_PACK,
+                        out_dtype=OUT_DTYPE)
+    tl.store(out_ptr + tl.arange(0, M)[:, None] * N + tl.arange(0, N)[None, :], out)
+
+
+def _operand(rows, cols, format, axis, phase=0):
+    codes = (torch.arange(rows)[:, None] * 7 + torch.arange(cols)[None, :] * 5 + phase) % 16
+    if format == "e2m1":
+        values = torch.tensor([0., .5, 1., 1.5, 2., 3., 4., 6., -0., -.5, -1., -1.5, -2., -3., -4., -6.])[codes]
+        packed = (codes[0::2, :] | (codes[1::2, :] << 4)) if axis == 0 else (codes[:, 0::2] | (codes[:, 1::2] << 4))
+        return packed.to(torch.uint8).contiguous().npu(), values
+    dtype = {"fp16": torch.float16, "bf16": torch.bfloat16, "e4m3": torch.float8_e4m3fn, "e5m2":
+             torch.float8_e5m2}[format]
+    values = ((codes.float() - 7) / 8).to(dtype)
+    return values.contiguous().npu(), values.float()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("a_k_pack,b_k_pack", [(True, True), (True, False), (False, True), (False, False)])

+    if not is_compile_on_910_95(triton.runtime.driver.active.get_current_target().arch):
+        pytest.skip("FP4 operands require Ascend 950")
+    m, n, k = 16, 32, 32
+    a, ar = _operand(m, k, "e2m1", 1 if a_k_pack else 0)
+    b, br = _operand(k, n, "e2m1", 0 if b_k_pack else 1, phase=3)
+    sa = torch.full((m, 1), 128, dtype=torch.uint8, device="npu")  # Scale 2.
+    sb = torch.full((n, 1), 126, dtype=torch.uint8, device="npu")  # Scale 0.5.
+    actual = torch.empty((m, n), dtype=torch.float32, device="npu")
+    _scaled_dot[(1, )](a, b, sa, sb, actual, m, n, k, "e2m1", "e2m1", a_k_pack, b_k_pack, 32)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual.cpu(), (ar * 2.) @ (br * .5) + .125, atol=0, rtol=0)

index tensor (discrete gather) and the last dim is strided by 2, so both parity
loads share one ExtractedLoadOrStore loop and the deinterleave writeback must
land in the loop-external buffer. Without the fix the kernel fails to compile
with "memref.alloc op error: read before first write".
